The '''Manali system'''<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Manali system]]</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="JK">[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]]</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[battle group/Legends|battle group]] that accompanied the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[New Hope]]'' was dispatched to Menali for an errand of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The errand took at least six [[standard day/Legends|standard days]], as the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnaught]] remained almost defenseless in the [[Milagro system/Legends|Milagro system]] during that time.<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
This star system was only mentioned in the [[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|audio adaption]] of the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'', which was released in [[1998]]. As the system's name was only given in spoken dialogue from the audio adaption, the actual spelling could not be determined<ref name="JK" /> until [[2025]], when the "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]" appendix of star systems introduced the [[Manali system]] to the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' canon.<ref name="Appendix" />
